description: Seismiske linjer, 2D is a dataset listed in National Data Catalog of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Norges geologiske undersøkelse. Seismiske linjer, 2D viser hvor NGU har samlet inn seismiske data og sedimentekkoloddata. Databasen inneholder også data fra MAREANO og en del eksterne data, blant annet fra IKU (Institutt for kontinentalsokkelundersøkelser). Coverage: Norges geologiske undersøkelse. The publisher named on the listing is Norges geologiske undersøkelse. Its keywords include havbunn, Nordsjøen, Sea regions, fellesDatakatalog, kartlegging, kontinentalsokkel. The listing shows 1 download or service links in GDB. The listing shows 2020-11-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data (NLOD) 2.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-norge-no.
